as_of_market_inputs: 2026-11-13 local Friday closes and official rate observations
definition: At least 3 of 6 equity Friday Nov20 returns vs Friday Nov13 <= -1.5%; identical local closing convention
method: Replay seeded centered-Bernoulli common shock 12-market Monte Carlo in original generator order, preserve draw correlation, compute six per-market P(return<=-1.5). Exact Poisson-binomial P(count>=3) is SAME-MARGINAL INDEPENDENCE shadow benchmark. Compare to common-shock event P from archived corrected Nov14 forecast.
registration: This is a Saturday post-12:00 shadow benchmark written before Nov16-Nov20 future outcomes. It is NOT the original Saturday noon frozen forecast. Append-only, no retrospective redefinition.
risk_quality: WTI joint risk conditional only; futures contract matching not authenticated. The six-index breadth excludes WTI.
limitations: No estimated historical covariance or calibrated return process; all probabilities conditional on assumed shocks and volatilities.
Independent shadow probability shares simulated marginals but is not an independently fitted statistical model.
20k draws x 6 seeds measure Monte Carlo seed sensitivity only, not sampling uncertainty from weekly markets.
Asian/European/U.S. session closures staggered, common-shock model lacks event-time exposure mapping.
This experiment must remain separate from the original 12:00 three-arm archive and may not be used to claim historic weekly skill.
